title: ComponentError
description: The structured error a component returns in a response frame's 'error' member. Deliberately the same shape as the protocol's EngineError, because the kernel passes it through verbatim (protocol spec §10.2) and a second error shape at that boundary would only need translating. See spec.md §11.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Open vocabulary; an unknown code is handled by its category (spec.md §11.1).

category.description: Coarse classification, so an unknown code is still handled sanely. Absent or unknown is treated as 'internal'.

source.description: Who produced this error. 'component' is the default; 'engine' marks an error the binding synthesised because the component trapped, timed out or exited (spec.md §11.2) — a distinction that sends a reader to a different place.

details.description: Code-specific structure per spec.md §11.1 — e.g. 'op' (operation-unsupported), 'operator'/'action' (unknown-*), 'content-type' and 'path' (decode-failed), 'grant' (capability-denied).
